title: salvia officinalis subsp. tomentosa
intro: Salvia officinalis subsp. tomentosa, commonly known as Woolly Sage, is a subspecies of the Salvia officinalis plant, a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function due to its antioxidant and neuroprotective properties. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Sage are attributed to its ability to relax the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, such as carnosic acid and ursolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
